limitations: Point-in-time GitHub readback; canonical execution must revalidate mutable refs and authority.
No owner consent was supplied or presumed, and no owner comment or retirement collector was executed.
Writer stop is its actual ACK and continuing commitment, not an automatic global census of unknown actors.
Raw repository bodies remain only in remote-readback-raw/ and must be excluded from the report ZIP/Library. This report contains metadata, hashes, URLs and verification results only.
